rationale: The condition requires obtaining observations needed to evaluate competing explanations. It does not require those observations to establish distinguishability; their acquisition enables the stated procedure without changing its mechanism, warrant, inference or target.

if_execution.verification_or_satisfaction_method: Collect and join request latency, path, load, version and deployment-timing records to supply the stated matched-load, bypass-path, old-version and deployment-onset observations for comparison.
